Google.Cloud.CommerceProducer.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.CommerceProducer.V1Beta

Google.Backstory version 1.0.0-beta02

New features

  • Remove un-needed Google.Api.Gax.Grcp dependency

Google.Cloud.NetworkConnectivity.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta02

New features

  • Add ParseFromActivationKey RPC, ProviderType enum, and PSC routing fields (psc_routing_enabled, hub, auto_accept) to v1beta Transport and TransportManagerService
  • Add export_psc_config field (ExportPscConfig) to v1beta Hub along with PSC_GLOBAL_GAPI (DynamicRouteType)

Documentation improvements

  • Update comments and docstrings on remote_profile, provided_activation_key, network, and remote_account_id in v1beta Transport

Google.Cloud.Support.V2Beta version 1.0.0-beta05

New features

  • A new method ExpungeSupportEventSubscription is added to service SupportEventSubscriptionService
  • A new message ExpungeSupportEventSubscriptionRequest is added

Bug fixes

  • Align HTTP paths with enforced matching

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for method ListSupportEventSubscriptions in service SupportEventSubscriptionService is changed
